description: This file defines a React component for the notes application's main route, including loaders and actions for server-side data fetching and manipulation, as well as client-side state management, UI rendering, and user interactions for creating, editing, deleting, and filtering notes.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: React component serving as the main interface for note management, incorporating file loader and action handlers, managing local state, and rendering the UI elements for note creation, editing, filtering, and display.

methods.name: handleNew
methods.description: Creates a new note, updates state accordingly to set it as active, and resets input fields.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current note (either creating or updating), updates local state, shows a toast message.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Exports the current note content as a .txt file for download.

methods.name: toggleTag
methods.description: Toggles the inclusion of a tag in the current note's tags.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a new tag to the list of all tags and to the current note if not already present.
